backTranslation.ai.consent.a.title: Should the AI record assistant be turned on?
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.lead: Using your records it creates weekly summaries and general meal ideas and explains how the app is used. The answers are given not by a human but by artificial intelligence, and it does not give medical advice.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.sent.title: What is sent
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.sent.body: Before the records are sent we show you the content, and nothing is sent until you tap "Send". Dose counts (on time, late, skipped), the change in the weight you entered yourself, how many times you recorded each symptom type, the number of days with a meal record together with your protein average and goal, and your streak in weeks are sent. For meal ideas the meal type you chose, preferences, allergies and foods you do not like are also sent. Your language and region setting and the questions you write are also sent; to app help only the app version, platform and current screen are added.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.notSent.body: Medicine names or doses, notes, food names, photos, dates, or your name, e-mail address or account information are not sent. What you write in the question field is sent in the form you wrote it.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.notSent.health.ios: Information imported from Apple Health is not sent.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.notSent.health.android: Information imported from Health Connect is not sent.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.where.title: Where it is processed
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.where.body: The app encrypts the content once more and sends it to the DoseWeek server (Seoul, Republic of Korea), and the Amazon Bedrock service of Amazon Web Services (Seoul region) processes the content. The artificial-intelligence model is Anthropic's Claude model. AWS operates the model and Anthropic cannot see the content.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.retention.title: How long it is kept
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.retention.body: What you send and the answers are not kept on the server and are not used for artificial-intelligence training. The answers are saved only on your device. Usage counts (without content) are stored for at most 2 months, and consent records as long as your account exists. If you report an answer and choose the option "Also send the answer text", only that answer is stored for 30 days.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.e2ee.title: This is not end-to-end encryption
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.e2ee.body: While the artificial intelligence creates an answer, the DoseWeek server and Amazon Bedrock can read what you sent. Sync and backup data continue to be protected by end-to-end encryption as now.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.optional.title: You do not have to accept
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.optional.body: Only the artificial-intelligence features cannot be used; the other features of Pro and Plus continue to work. You can withdraw your consent whenever you want from Settings > AI record assistant.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.check.health: [Optional] I accept the processing of my health (sensitive) information
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.check.health.detail: Purpose: creating AI weekly summaries and meal ideas, answering questions about app use / Data: the records in the "What is sent" section above and the questions I write / Storage: deleted as soon as the answer is created (if an answer is attached to a report, only that answer 30 days) / If you refuse, everything other than artificial intelligence continues to work
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.check.age: I am 18 years old or older
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.region.jp: The records you send are processed on the operator's server (Republic of Korea) and in the Amazon Bedrock service of Amazon Web Services (Seoul Region, Republic of Korea). In the Republic of Korea the Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) is in force, and the Personal Information Protection Commission carries out its supervision. DoseWeek takes measures such as a no-retention setting, a setting of no use in AI training and encrypted communication.
backTranslation.ai.consent.a.region.us: View the US Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.title: Should these records be sent to the AI?
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.purpose.weekly: A weekly summary is created from your records of the last 7 days.
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.purpose.meal: General meal ideas are created from the meal type you chose and the preferences.
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.row.doses: Dose records (on-time, late and skipped counts)
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.weight.excluded.ios: Weight imported from the Apple Health app is not sent
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.weight.excluded.android: Weight imported from Health Connect is not sent
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.preview: See in detail the content to be sent
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.processing: The app encrypts the content, Amazon Bedrock (Seoul) processes it and the content is deleted as soon as the answer is created.
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.quota.weekly: This week's summary is not counted toward your usage.
backTranslation.ai.consent.b.quota.regenerate: Creating it again counts as 1 request. Remaining this month: {count}
backTranslation.ai.help.inputNote: When you send, this text is passed to the AI service (AWS Seoul Region)
backTranslation.ai.settings.title: AI record assistant
backTranslation.ai.settings.withdraw.note: After you withdraw your consent, no records are sent to the AI. Your Pro subscription is not cancelled automatically.
backTranslation.ai.settings.withdraw.store.ios: You can change your subscription from App Store subscription management.
backTranslation.ai.settings.withdraw.store.android: You can change your subscription from Google Play subscription management.
backTranslation.pro.support.priority: Priority reply to questions — We send the first reply to questions about using the app within 1 business day. We do not answer medical questions.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.dose: I cannot determine your dose or when you will apply it. This depends on your prescription and your body's reaction; please consult your health professional who prescribed the medicine. Instead I can summarize your dose records so far. Shall I prepare a summary to show at your next examination?
backTranslation.ai.refuse.sideEffect: I cannot assess whether a symptom is normal or whether it results from the medicine. If it continues or worries you, consult your health professional. I can summarize the symptoms you recorded.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.diagnosis: Only a doctor can assess whether you have a disease or your likelihood of catching one. Consult your health professional about your questions. I can help you prepare the questions you want to ask at the examination.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.drugInfo: I cannot answer whether you can use other medicines or supplements together or which medicine is more suitable for you. Tell your health professional everything you use and consult them.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.diet: I cannot give diets aimed at diseases or intake targets. Consult your health professional about the amount of food and your weight goals. I can give general meal ideas that will help you get protein and fluid.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.pregnancy: I cannot guide on medicine use and nutrition in pregnancy or the breastfeeding period. Please consult your health professional.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.minor: The AI record assistant is only for persons aged 18 and over. If you have questions about health, consult a health professional together with a parent or your guardian.
backTranslation.ai.refuse.other: I cannot help on this subject. I can always help with organizing your records, general meal ideas or using the app.
backTranslation.ai.emergency: If your symptoms are severe or suddenly getting worse, do not wait. Call the number {text} at once or go to the nearest emergency service. I cannot assess whether it is an emergency.
backTranslation.ai.emergency.generic: If your symptoms are severe or suddenly getting worse, do not wait. Call the local emergency number at once or go to the nearest emergency service. I cannot assess whether it is an emergency.
backTranslation.ai.crisis: You seem to be going through a very difficult period. You do not have to cope with this on your own. To talk to someone at any hour of the day, call the number {text} at once. If you are under imminent danger, call the number {text2}.
backTranslation.ai.crisis.generic: You seem to be going through a very difficult period. You do not have to cope with this on your own. At the address {text} you can find a helpline in your region. If you are under imminent danger, call the local emergency number.
backTranslation.ai.label.header: This is the AI record assistant. The answers are given not by a human but by artificial intelligence.
backTranslation.ai.label.output: It was created by artificial intelligence and may be faulty. It is not medical advice. For decisions about your health consult your health professional.
backTranslation.ai.label.export: Content created by artificial intelligence · DoseWeek
